Experimental review rule: an incorrect answer returns in 10 minutes. Correct first answers and due reviews move the next review to 1, 3, 7 and 14 days later. Early correct practice does not change the review time.
Build your knowledge through practice and review.

Only topics you have practised are compared. If scores are tied, the first topic is shown.
Your strongest and weakest topics appear once you start practising.

How is mastery calculated? A correct first answer or due review adds 25 points to a question. An early correct answer does not add points or move the review time. An incorrect answer subtracts 35 points. Scores range from 0 to 100. Topic and overall mastery average the question scores; unseen questions count as zero. This is a demo rule, not an estimate of official test readiness.

The app checks the file format and update rules. It does not verify factual accuracy, official origin or reuse rights. Import only material you trust.

Unchanged questions and translation-only updates keep their progress. New questions and revised study content start at zero mastery. Removed questions leave practice and review. All saved answer history remains.
